Autonomously executable next steps are internal execution state, not user handoff.
Every material incident/recovery/change is registered in the existing Powerhouse dashboard/current-state and activity lineage and read back.
Only a proven BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY can return ownership before terminal proof, with one smallest required human action.
Interrupted work resumes automatically from canonical state without requiring the user to say ga door.
